scope: Cloud Account name, email and password editing

sourceEvidence.use: Grouped rows and Account navigation pattern only; original local screen has no credential editor.
Saved local Account page inspected; no claim of native credential-editor pixel parity.
Installed session Account updateName/updateEmail/updatePassword contracts; email verification resets after update.

integration: Parent-owned POST /api/account/update validates explicit discriminator and calls session-bound updateAccount. No workspace records, mutation receipts, API keys or provider credentials are exposed or persisted. Existing lifecycle operation ownership remains unchanged.
behavior: Compact identity rows open Save/Cancel dialogs; current password required for email and password changes.
Email verification state comes from Appwrite and existing verification action remains available.
Passwords clear on submission, mismatch, failure and dialog disposal; no automatic replay of credential updates.
Lost name/email replies reconcile the exact intended identity through authenticated GET; unresolved outcomes retain a Check account action. Unknown password saves offer sign-in/reset.
Existing settings, account deletion, sign-out and saved appearance remain available.
